subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit orphan-skill diagnostic, and should it run in doctor, openclaw skills check, status, startup, or some combination?
rationale: The missing behavior is real from source inspection, but scanning outside configured roots affects privacy, performance, noise, and operator trust policy, so automation should not choose the product boundary alone.

options.title: Doctor And Skills Check Diagnostic
options.body: Add a bounded non-startup diagnostic for likely orphan SKILL.md directories with clear allowlist/config guidance; this addresses the report without surprising every gateway startup.

options.title: Startup Warning Too
options.body: Also warn during gateway startup, accepting more immediate visibility at the cost of potential noise and filesystem scanning concerns.

options.title: No Broad Orphan Scan
options.body: Keep the current explicit-root model and document that external skill roots must be configured with skills.load.extraDirs instead of auto-discovered.

recommendation.title: Doctor And Skills Check Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add a bounded non-startup diagnostic for likely orphan SKILL.md directories with clear allowlist/config guidance; this addresses the report without surprising every gateway startup.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the bundled skill-creator and adjacent workspace skill audit behavior, making him the best history-backed owner for the diagnostic boundary decision.
